comparison.objective: Tear a loaded shelf-ready tray’s front panel off along its perforation while preserving the tray and cans; candidate commissions and locks a rigid-body damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires bimanual hold-and-peel force control along sequential breakable ties. Candidate requires precision tool insertion, counterholding, collar rotation, screw locking, and iterative impact-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires full panel removal without off-line tearing, tray displacement/tip, or can loss, followed by release and stillness. Candidate requires two compliant stops without bottoming, hard-stop contact, overload, rebound, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: PR tests controlled destructive separation of a perforated deformable package; the candidate tests reversible adjustment and retention of a rigid industrial mechanism under dynamic load. Candidate numeric rebound, overload, and drift thresholds are missing.
